cards.name: IVGDuotoneInk
cards.summary: One ink of a bitmap's monotone / duotone / tritone / quadtone setting: its colour plus the tone curve that decides how much of that ink prints at each grey level of the source image.
use_for: two-colour print jobs: turning a grayscale photo into a Pantone duotone
brand-colour duotone poster imagery done inside CorelDRAW
reusing a house ink curve across many bitmaps via .cik files
avoid: RGB screen work where a duotone mode is not needed: a lens or a fill-based colourise is simpler
colour photos you want to keep: the bitmap has to be converted to Duotone mode, which discards the original colour
cards.how: Dispinterface (dual) for one ink inside an IVGDuotone. Reach it from a bitmap shape: Shape.Bitmap.Duotone returns the IVGDuotone, and Duotone.Inks(i) returns this object (InkCount says how many). Edit Color and the curve (AddHandle / HandleX / HandleY / PutHandles), then apply with Bitmap.ConvertToDuotone(duotone).

key_members.name: Color
key_members.use: IVGColor of the ink (often a spot / Pantone colour); read-write

key_members.name: HandleCount
key_members.use: read-only number of handles on the tone curve

key_members.name: HandleX
key_members.use: HandleX(Index): input (source grey) position of one curve handle; read-write

key_members.name: HandleY
key_members.use: HandleY(Index): output ink level of one curve handle; read-write

key_members.name: AddHandle
key_members.use: AddHandle(x, y) adds a curve point and returns its index

key_members.name: RemoveHandle
key_members.use: RemoveHandle(Index) deletes a curve point; returns success

key_members.name: FindHandle
key_members.use: FindHandle(x, y) returns the index of the handle at those coordinates

key_members.name: Reset
key_members.use: reset the tone curve to its default

key_members.name: GetCurveLevels
key_members.use: array of 256 resulting ink levels, one per input level

key_members.name: CurveLevel
key_members.use: CurveLevel(Index): read-only ink level at one input level

key_members.name: GetHandles
key_members.use: all handle positions as one array

key_members.name: PutHandles
key_members.use: replace every handle from an array (optional NumElements)

key_members.name: Load
key_members.use: Load(FileName) reads ink settings from a .cik file

key_members.name: Save
key_members.use: Save(FileName) writes ink settings to a .cik file

gotchas: The bitmap must end up in Duotone mode: editing an ink of the IVGDuotone you read may not change the image until you pass it back with Bitmap.ConvertToDuotone (unverified)
Handle coordinates are long integers and the typelib gives no range for them; GetCurveLevels returns 256 levels, so read GetHandles on a default curve to learn the scale before writing (unverified)
Layout of the GetHandles / PutHandles array (interleaved x,y pairs or two blocks) is not documented in the typelib; read GetHandles first and mirror its shape (unverified)
Inks(i) indexing is assumed 1-based like other CorelDRAW collections (unverified)
cards.example:
Dim d As Duotone, ink As DuotoneInk
Set d = ActiveShape.Bitmap.Duotone
Set ink = d.Inks(1)
ink.Reset
ink.AddHandle 128, 170
ActiveShape.Bitmap.ConvertToDuotone d

review.changes: Reset use no longer claims a linear default curve (typelib only says it resets the curve); removed the invented 0-255 handle range from a gotcha.

cards.name: IVGDuotoneOverprint
cards.summary: One overprint combination of a duotone / tritone / quadtone bitmap: the colour shown where two or more of its inks overlap, with an optional override colour. The typelib calls Cyan / Magenta / Yellow / Black the colour components of the ink combination; whether they are percentages or flags naming which inks take part is not confirmed.
use_for: making the on-screen preview of a duotone match the printer's actual overprint colour
proofing two-spot-colour jobs where the ink mix looks wrong on screen
avoid: changing what prints: overprint colours set how the ink overlap is shown, not the ink curves; edit IVGDuotoneInk curves instead (unverified)
cards.how: Dispinterface (dual). From a bitmap: Shape.Bitmap.Duotone gives the IVGDuotone; Duotone.Overprints(i) returns this object (OverprintCount says how many combinations exist). Set Duotone.UseOverprints = True for the overrides to be used, and Duotone.ResetOverprints restores the defaults.

key_members.name: Color
key_members.use: IVGColor override shown for this overlap combination

key_members.name: Cyan
key_members.use: long: cyan component of the combination (meaning of the value unconfirmed)

key_members.name: Magenta
key_members.use: long: magenta component of the combination

key_members.name: Yellow
key_members.use: long: yellow component of the combination

key_members.name: Black
key_members.use: long: black component of the combination

key_members.name: SetValues
key_members.use: SetValues(Cyan, Magenta, Yellow, Black) sets all four components in one call

key_members.name: Reset
key_members.use: restore this combination's default overprint colour

gotchas: Overrides are ignored unless the parent IVGDuotone has UseOverprints = True (unverified)
A monotone has no ink overlaps, so OverprintCount is expected to be 0 there (unverified)
Typelib descriptions do not say whether Cyan..Black are percentages or ink-membership values; read them back from a known duotone before writing (unverified)
cards.example:
Dim d As Duotone, o As DuotoneOverprint
Set d = ActiveShape.Bitmap.Duotone
d.UseOverprints = True
Set o = d.Overprints(1)
o.Color.CMYKAssign 0, 60, 100, 20
ActiveShape.Bitmap.ConvertToDuotone d

review.changes: Removed the invented 0-100 range from a gotcha; avoid no longer claims overprint colours change separations (contradicted its own preview-only use_for).

cards.name: IVGEdgeSnapPoint
cards.summary: The extra data of a snap point that sits on a curve's edge rather than on a node: which segment it lies on and how far along that segment (a parametric offset).
use_for: finding exactly where a snapped connector, dimension or guide touches a path
splitting or adding a node at the spot a snap point marks
avoid: node snap points: use the snap point's Node instead; Edge is only meaningful for edge-type points
cards.how: Dispinterface (dual), read-only. Reached from an IVGSnapPoint whose Type is cdrSnapPointEdge via SnapPoint.Edge; the snap point itself comes from Shape.SnapPoints, Shape.SnapPointsOfType or Shape.FindSnapPoint(ReferenceData).

key_members.name: SegmentIndex
key_members.use: read-only index of the curve segment the point lies on

key_members.name: SegmentOffset
key_members.use: read-only parametric position (time t) along that segment

gotchas: SegmentOffset is the curve's time parameter, not a length: on a Bezier segment 0.5 is not necessarily the halfway distance (unverified)
Edge on a snap point of another type (node, bbox, object) is expected to fail or return Nothing; check SnapPoint.Type first (unverified)
Edge snap points are usually created on the fly by connectors and dimensions, so SnapPoints may not list them (unverified)
cards.example:
Dim sp As SnapPoint
For Each sp In ActiveShape.SnapPoints
  If sp.Type = cdrSnapPointEdge Then
    Debug.Print sp.Edge.SegmentIndex, sp.Edge.SegmentOffset
  End If
Next

cards.name: IVGEffect
cards.summary: The generic handle for one live (dynamic) effect on a shape (blend, contour, drop shadow, inner shadow, extrude, envelope, distortion, perspective, lens, text on path, custom): Type says which, a typed property returns its settings, and Clear / Separate remove it or break it into plain shapes.
use_for: auditing a file for live effects before sending it to print or a cutter
breaking shadows / blends / contours apart into editable shapes for hand-finishing
stripping effects from imported client artwork
avoid: bitmap effects from the Effects menu such as Gaussian blur: cdrEffectType has no bitmap-effect type; they go through Bitmap.ApplyBitmapEffect and Shape.FlattenEffects instead
reading a typed property that does not match Type: check Type first
cards.how: Dispinterface (dual). Returned by every Shape.CreateXxx effect call (CreateDropShadow, CreateBlend, CreateContour ...), by Shape.Effects.Item(i) and the Shape.Effects shortcuts (DropShadowEffect, ContourEffect ...), and by Shape.Effect on an effect's own group. Branch on Type (cdrEffectType) and then use the matching typed property.

key_members.name: Type
key_members.use: cdrEffectType: cdrBlend, cdrExtrude, cdrEnvelope, cdrTextOnPath, cdrControlPath, cdrDropShadow, cdrContour, cdrDistortion, cdrPerspective, cdrLens, cdrCustomEffect, cdrInnerShadow

key_members.name: Blend
key_members.use: IVGEffectBlend settings when Type = cdrBlend

key_members.name: Contour
key_members.use: IVGEffectContour settings

key_members.name: DropShadow
key_members.use: IVGEffectDropShadow settings

key_members.name: InnerShadow
key_members.use: IVGEffectInnerShadow settings

key_members.name: Extrude
key_members.use: IVGEffectExtrude settings

key_members.name: Envelope
key_members.use: IVGEffectEnvelope settings

key_members.name: Distortion
key_members.use: IVGEffectDistortion settings

key_members.name: Perspective
key_members.use: IVGEffectPerspective settings

key_members.name: Lens
key_members.use: IVGEffectLens settings

key_members.name: TextOnPath
key_members.use: IVGEffectTextOnPath settings

key_members.name: ControlPath
key_members.use: IVGEffectControlPath when the shape is a path driving blends / fitted text

key_members.name: Custom
key_members.use: IVGCustomEffect for plug-in (custom) effects

key_members.name: Clear
key_members.use: remove the effect and return the shape to its plain state

key_members.name: Separate
key_members.use: break the effect into ordinary shapes; returns the resulting IVGShapeRange

key_members.name: Clones
key_members.use: effects cloned from this one (Object > Clone Effect)

key_members.name: CloneParent
key_members.use: the effect this one was cloned from

key_members.name: Parent
key_members.use: the IVGEffects collection holding this effect

gotchas: The typelib text says Clear and Separate act on 'the blend effect', but they are generic and act on whatever effect this is (unverified)
A typed property that does not match Type (e.g. .Blend on a drop shadow) errors or returns Nothing; branch on Type (unverified)
After Separate or Clear the IVGEffect reference is dead; re-query Shape.Effects instead of reusing it (unverified)
Separating a drop or inner shadow leaves a bitmap shadow, not vectors (unverified)
cards.example:
Dim e As Effect
For Each e In ActiveShape.Effects
  Select Case e.Type
    Case cdrDropShadow: e.DropShadow.Opacity = 40
    Case cdrContour: e.Contour.Steps = 3
  End Select
Next

review.changes: Clones: menu path corrected to Object > Clone Effect (harvested cdr_menu path); avoid no longer calls PowerClip a bitmap effect and names the real bitmap-effect calls (Bitmap.ApplyBitmapEffect, Shape.FlattenEffects).

cards.name: IVGEffectBlend
cards.summary: Settings of a live blend (Blend tool): a group of intermediate shapes that morph shape and colour from a start object to an end object, either as a fixed number of steps or spaced along a path, optionally rotating to follow it.
use_for: smooth colour transitions and stripe/stepped gradients built from vectors
repeating an object evenly along a path: dotted borders, chains, footprints
retro stacked-line and 3D-ish text effects
neon / halo glows by blending an outline to a fainter copy
avoid: a simple two-colour gradient: a fountain fill is lighter and edits faster
blends with hundreds of steps on complex shapes: heavy files and slow redraw; lower Steps or use a fountain fill
cards.how: Dispinterface (dual). Created with StartShape.CreateBlend(EndShape, Steps, ...) which returns an IVGEffect; its .Blend property is this object. Also reached via Shape.Effects.BlendEffects(i).Blend. Change Steps / Spacing / Path / colour options in place; BlendGroup is the generated intermediate group.

key_members.name: StartShape
key_members.use: control object the blend starts from; settable

key_members.name: EndShape
key_members.use: control object the blend ends on; settable

key_members.name: Steps
key_members.use: number of intermediate shapes

key_members.name: Mode
key_members.use: cdrBlendMode: cdrBlendSteps (fixed count) or cdrBlendSpacing (fixed distance)

key_members.name: Spacing
key_members.use: distance between intermediates when Mode = cdrBlendSpacing

key_members.name: Path
key_members.use: curve shape the blend follows; set to put the blend on a path

key_members.name: FullPath
key_members.use: stretch the blend over the whole path

key_members.name: RotateShapes
key_members.use: rotate intermediates to follow the path direction

key_members.name: Angle
key_members.use: rotation spread across the intermediates

key_members.name: Loop
key_members.use: loop the rotation (works with Angle)

key_members.name: ColorBlendType
key_members.use: cdrFountainFillBlendType: direct or rainbow (CW / CCW) colour progression

key_members.name: SpacingAcceleration
key_members.use: bunch intermediates toward one end (long)

key_members.name: ColorAcceleration
key_members.use: push the colour change toward one end (long)

key_members.name: LinkAcceleration
key_members.use: lock colour acceleration to spacing acceleration

key_members.name: AccelerateSize
key_members.use: apply acceleration to size as well

key_members.name: MapNodes
key_members.use: use StartPoint / EndPoint to choose which nodes map to each other

key_members.name: BlendGroup
key_members.use: read-only group of the generated intermediates

key_members.name: Split
key_members.use: Split(StepNo) splits the blend at an intermediate, making it a new control shape

key_members.name: FuseStart
key_members.use: fuse a split / compound blend back at its start

key_members.name: CopyFrom
key_members.use: copy all blend settings from another IVGEffectBlend

gotchas: Spacing only works when the blend sits on a Path; on a straight blend use Steps (unverified)
Typelib describes Parent with the wrong text ('application'); it returns the owning IVGEffect
Start and end shapes with different node counts twist mid-blend; set MapNodes with StartPoint / EndPoint to control the morph (unverified)
SpacingAcceleration / ColorAcceleration are longs, not booleans, despite the 'whether or not' wording; the typelib gives no range
cards.example:
Dim s1 As Shape, s2 As Shape, e As Effect
Set s1 = ActiveLayer.CreateEllipse2(1, 1, 0.3)
Set s2 = ActiveLayer.CreateEllipse2(6, 1, 0.3)
Set e = s1.CreateBlend(s2, 12)
e.Blend.ColorBlendType = cdrRainbowCWFountainFillBlend
e.Blend.Steps = 20

review.changes: Removed the invented -100..100 acceleration range from a gotcha.

cards.name: IVGEffectContour
cards.summary: Settings of a live contour (Contour tool): concentric copies of a shape offset inside, outside or to the centre, stepping their fill and outline colours from the original to a target colour.
use_for: cut-line / bleed outlines around stickers and die-cut labels (outside, 1 step)
layered retro outline text and topographic ring patterns
keylines and offset borders around logos
avoid: a soft glow: contour steps are hard-edged; use a drop shadow with zero offset or a blend
a single permanent offset outline you will edit as a path: create the contour then Separate it, or use Curve.Contour
cards.how: Dispinterface (dual). Created with Shape.CreateContour(Direction, Offset, Steps, ...) which returns an IVGEffect; .Contour is this object. Also reached via Shape.Effects.ContourEffect.Contour. Offset is in document units; ContourGroup holds the generated rings.

key_members.name: Direction
key_members.use: cdrContourDirection: cdrContourInside, cdrContourOutside, cdrContourToCenter

key_members.name: Offset
key_members.use: distance between rings (document units)

key_members.name: Steps
key_members.use: number of rings

key_members.name: FillColor
key_members.use: IVGColor the last ring's fill blends to

key_members.name: FillColorTo
key_members.use: second target colour used when the source has a fountain fill

key_members.name: OutlineColor
key_members.use: IVGColor the last ring's outline blends to

key_members.name: ColorBlendType
key_members.use: cdrFountainFillBlendType: direct or rainbow colour progression

key_members.name: SpacingAcceleration
key_members.use: bunch rings toward one end (long)

key_members.name: ColorAcceleration
key_members.use: push the colour change toward one end (long)

key_members.name: LinkAcceleration
key_members.use: lock colour acceleration to spacing

key_members.name: CornerType
key_members.use: cdrContourCornerType: bevel, round, mitered ... at cusp corners

key_members.name: MiterLimit
key_members.use: angle limit before mitered corners are bevelled

key_members.name: EndCapType
key_members.use: cdrContourEndCapType: butt / round / square ends on open paths

key_members.name: ContourGroup
key_members.use: read-only group of the generated contour shapes

gotchas: With cdrContourToCenter the step count follows from Offset and shape size; Steps is ignored (unverified)
Too large an inside Offset on thin shapes produces no rings at all (unverified)
FillColorTo only matters when the source object has a fountain fill; with a uniform fill only FillColor is used (unverified)
cards.example:
Dim e As Effect
Set e = ActiveShape.CreateContour(cdrContourOutside, 0.1, 1)
e.Contour.CornerType = cdrContourCornerRound
e.Contour.OutlineColor.CMYKAssign 0, 100, 0, 0

cards.name: IVGEffectControlPath
cards.summary: The role a curve plays when it drives other effects: the path that a blend follows or that text is fitted to. Its only payload is the collection of those blend and text-on-path effects.
use_for: finding every blend / fitted text that depends on a path before moving, editing or deleting it
batch-updating all blends that run along one guide path
avoid: reading blend or text settings directly: go through Effects(i).Blend / .TextOnPath
cards.how: Dispinterface (dual). Reached from the path shape: Shape.Effects.ControlPathEffect returns an IVGEffect of Type cdrControlPath, whose .ControlPath is this object.

key_members.name: Effects
key_members.use: IVGEffects collection of the blend and text-on-path effects driven by this path

key_members.name: Parent
key_members.use: the owning IVGEffect (Type cdrControlPath)

key_members.name: Application
key_members.use: the CorelDRAW application object

gotchas: ControlPathEffect is expected to return Nothing on a curve that drives nothing; test before using it (unverified)
Deleting the control path detaches or removes the dependent blends / fitted text (unverified)
cards.example:
Dim e As Effect
Set e = ActiveShape.Effects.ControlPathEffect
If Not e Is Nothing Then
  Debug.Print e.ControlPath.Effects.Count
End If

cards.name: IVGEffectCustomDistortion
cards.summary: Read-only identity of a custom (non push-pull / zipper / twister) distortion on a shape; the only harvested member is DistortionID, a string naming which custom distortion was applied. The typelib carries no description and which distortions use this path is not confirmed.
use_for: identifying a custom distortion found while auditing a file's effects
avoid: editing distortion settings: this interface exposes none; remove and reapply with Shape.CreateCustomDistortion
cards.how: Dispinterface (dual). Reached via Shape.Effects.DistortionEffects(i).Distortion.Custom when Distortion.Type = cdrDistortionCustom. Custom distortions are applied with Shape.CreateCustomDistortion(DistortionID, Parameters).

key_members.name: DistortionID
key_members.use: read-only string id of the custom distortion (same id CreateCustomDistortion takes)

gotchas: No typelib description exists for the class or its member; the id format and the list of valid ids are unknown (unverified)
Distortion.Custom on a push-pull / zipper / twister distortion is expected to return Nothing or fail (unverified)
cards.example:
Dim e As Effect
For Each e In ActiveShape.Effects.DistortionEffects
  If e.Distortion.Type = cdrDistortionCustom Then
    Debug.Print e.Distortion.Custom.DistortionID
  End If
Next

cards.name: IVGEffectDistortion
cards.summary: Settings of a live distortion (Distort tool): which kind it is (push and pull, zipper, twister or custom), its centre point, and the kind-specific sub-object holding the amount.
use_for: badge and starburst shapes from a polygon (push and pull)
jagged comic-style bursts and torn edges (zipper)
swirled ornaments and spiral logos (twister)
avoid: precise geometric shapes: distortions are hard to control numerically; use Star / Polygon shapes or node editing
text you still need to edit cleanly: distortion makes small type unreadable fast
cards.how: Dispinterface (dual). Created with Shape.CreatePushPullDistortion(OriginX, OriginY, Amplitude), CreateZipperDistortion(...) or CreateTwisterDistortion(...), each returning an IVGEffect whose .Distortion is this object; also Shape.Effects.DistortionEffects(i).Distortion. Read Type, then use PushPull / Zipper / Twister.

key_members.name: Type
key_members.use: cdrDistortionType: cdrDistortionPushPull, cdrDistortionZipper, cdrDistortionTwister, cdrDistortionCustom

key_members.name: OriginX
key_members.use: X of the distortion centre

key_members.name: OriginY
key_members.use: Y of the distortion centre

key_members.name: CenterDistortion
key_members.use: move the centre to the middle of the object

key_members.name: PushPull
key_members.use: IVGEffectPushPullDistortion (Amplitude) when Type = push-pull

key_members.name: Zipper
key_members.use: IVGEffectZipperDistortion settings when Type = zipper

key_members.name: Twister
key_members.use: IVGEffectTwisterDistortion settings when Type = twister

key_members.name: Custom
key_members.use: IVGEffectCustomDistortion (DistortionID) when Type = custom

gotchas: Only the sub-object matching Type is usable; PushPull on a twister distortion fails or returns Nothing (unverified)
Setting Type on an existing distortion is not confirmed to convert it; Clear and recreate with the right CreateXxxDistortion call (unverified)
Origin coordinates are page coordinates in document units, not offsets from the shape (unverified)
cards.example:
Dim e As Effect
Set e = ActiveShape.CreatePushPullDistortion(0, 0, 40)
e.Distortion.CenterDistortion
If e.Distortion.Type = cdrDistortionPushPull Then
  e.Distortion.PushPull.Amplitude = -60
End If

cards.name: IVGEffectDropShadow
cards.summary: Settings of a live drop shadow (Drop Shadow tool): a soft bitmap shadow behind an object, either flat and offset or a perspective shadow cast from the bottom / top / left / right, with opacity, feather, colour, fade and merge (blend) mode.
use_for: lifting product shots, cards and buttons off the background
cast perspective shadows under cut-out products for packaging and ads
legibility shadows behind headline text on busy images
avoid: print jobs where a rasterised shadow over spot colours is a problem: build the shadow from a blend or a transparent vector instead
shadows inside a shape: use IVGEffectInnerShadow
cards.how: Dispinterface (dual). Created with Shape.CreateDropShadow(Type, Opacity, Feather, OffsetX, OffsetY, Color, ...) which returns an IVGEffect; .DropShadow is this object. Existing shadows: Shape.Effects.DropShadowEffect.DropShadow.

key_members.name: Type
key_members.use: cdrDropShadowType: cdrDropShadowFlat or a perspective cdrDropShadowBottom / Top / Left / Right

key_members.name: OffsetX
key_members.use: horizontal offset of a flat shadow (document units)

key_members.name: OffsetY
key_members.use: vertical offset of a flat shadow

key_members.name: SetOffset
key_members.use: SetOffset(OffsetX, OffsetY) in one call

key_members.name: Opacity
key_members.use: shadow opacity (long)

key_members.name: Feather
key_members.use: softness / blur length of the edge

key_members.name: FeatherType
key_members.use: cdrFeatherType: inside, middle, outside, average, Gaussian blur

key_members.name: FeatherEdge
key_members.use: cdrEdgeType falloff: linear, squared, flat, inverse squared, mesa, Gaussian

key_members.name: Color
key_members.use: IVGColor of the shadow

key_members.name: MergeMode
key_members.use: cdrMergeMode: how the shadow blends with what is below (multiply, normal ...)

key_members.name: PerspectiveAngle
key_members.use: angle of a perspective shadow

key_members.name: PerspectiveStretch
key_members.use: length of a perspective shadow

key_members.name: Fade
key_members.use: how much a perspective shadow fades with distance

key_members.name: ShadowGroup
key_members.use: read-only shape holding the rendered shadow bitmap

gotchas: Typelib descriptions for Type, Color, PerspectiveAngle, PerspectiveStretch and Fade say 'feather'; they are the shadow's type, colour and perspective settings
PerspectiveAngle, PerspectiveStretch and Fade only matter for the non-flat types; OffsetX / OffsetY only for cdrDropShadowFlat (unverified)
The shadow is a bitmap: it rasterises at the document's shadow resolution and separates as a bitmap when printed or exported (unverified)
Creating a shadow on a shape that already has one replaces it rather than stacking (unverified)
cards.example:
Dim e As Effect
Set e = ActiveShape.CreateDropShadow(cdrDropShadowFlat, 60, 12, 0.08, -0.08)
e.DropShadow.MergeMode = cdrMergeMultiply
e.DropShadow.Color.RGBAssign 20, 20, 40

review.changes: Opacity: removed the 0-100 range, which is not in the batch.

cards.name: IVGEffectEnvelope
cards.summary: Settings of a live envelope (Envelope tool): a container curve that the object is warped to fit, with a mapping mode (horizontal, original, putty or vertical) that sets how the object is stretched into it, optionally keeping straight lines straight.
use_for: arched and bulged headline text for badges, labels and signage
fitting artwork onto a shield, bottle or ribbon silhouette
fake-perspective wraps for packaging mock-ups
avoid: true two-point perspective: use IVGEffectPerspective
text that should stay on a single line along a curve: fit text to path instead (IVGEffectTextOnPath)
cards.how: Dispinterface (dual). Created with Shape.CreateEnvelope(PresetIndex, Mode, KeepLines), Shape.CreateEnvelopeFromShape(Source, ...) or CreateEnvelopeFromCurve(...), each returning an IVGEffect whose .Envelope is this object; existing ones via Shape.Effects.EnvelopeEffects(i).Envelope.

key_members.name: Container
key_members.use: IVGCurve of the envelope outline; edit its nodes to reshape the warp

key_members.name: Mode
key_members.use: cdrEnvelopeMode mapping: cdrEnvelopeHorizontal, cdrEnvelopeOriginal, cdrEnvelopePutty, cdrEnvelopeVertical

key_members.name: KeepLines
key_members.use: keep straight lines straight instead of bending them

key_members.name: Select
key_members.use: Select(PresetIndex) applies one of the built-in envelope presets

key_members.name: CopyFromShape
key_members.use: CopyFromShape(Source, Mode, KeepLines, CopyMode, CornerIndices) uses another shape's outline as the container

key_members.name: CopyFromCurve
key_members.use: same, from an IVGCurve

key_members.name: CreateFrom
key_members.use: CreateFrom(Shape) builds a new envelope from a shape

key_members.name: CopyFrom
key_members.use: copy settings from another IVGEffectEnvelope

key_members.name: CornerIndices
key_members.use: array of 4 node indices in Container that act as the deformed rectangle's corners

gotchas: Typelib names this interface 'EffectExtrudeVanishingPoint' in its description; it is the envelope interface

Mode is the mapping mode (the typelib calls each value 'envelope mapping'), not the Envelope tool's straight-line / single-arc / double-arc / unconstrained editing modes; reshape the warp through Container, Select(PresetIndex) or CopyFromShape
CopyFromShape with cdrEnvelopeUseOriginal can distort badly when the template's corner nodes are not where you expect; pass CornerIndices or use cdrEnvelopeFit (unverified)
Preset index order for Select is not documented in the typelib (unverified)
cards.example:
Dim e As Effect, tmpl As Shape
Set tmpl = ActiveLayer.CreateEllipse2(4, 4, 3, 1.5)
Set e = ActiveShape.CreateEnvelopeFromShape(tmpl, cdrEnvelopePutty, False, cdrEnvelopeFit)
tmpl.Delete

review.changes: Summary and Mode no longer confuse cdrEnvelopeMode with the tool's straight / single-arc / double-arc / unconstrained editing modes: it is the mapping mode (horizontal, original, putty, vertical, per the typelib). Replaced the wrong gotcha that mapped Original to unconstrained, Putty to curvy fit and so on. The example builds its own template ellipse, because ActivePage.Shapes(1) could be the active shape itself.

cards.name: IVGEffectExtrude
cards.summary: Settings of a live vector extrusion (Extrude tool): side faces projected toward a vanishing point or in parallel, with depth, 3D rotation, solid / object / shaded colouring, an optional bevel and up to several light sources, giving blocky 3D text and logos.
use_for: chunky 3D headline type for posters, sale banners and retro titles
isometric-looking logo blocks and signage
bevelled badge and button art
avoid: photoreal 3D with materials: extrusion is flat-shaded vector; use a 3D app or Illustrator's 3D and Materials
very complex outlines: extrusion multiplies objects and slows the file
cards.how: Dispinterface (dual). Created with Shape.CreateExtrude(Type, VPType, VPX, VPY, Depth, Shading, BaseColor, ShadingColor, ...) which returns an IVGEffect; .Extrude is this object. Existing ones: Shape.Effects.ExtrudeEffect.Extrude.

key_members.name: Type
key_members.use: cdrExtrudeType: small/big back/front (vanishing point) or back/front parallel

key_members.name: Depth
key_members.use: extrusion depth for vanishing-point types (long)

key_members.name: VanishingPoint
key_members.use: IVGExtrudeVanishingPoint: where the sides converge and how it is locked

key_members.name: AngleX
key_members.use: rotation about X

key_members.name: AngleY
key_members.use: rotation about Y

key_members.name: AngleZ
key_members.use: rotation about Z

key_members.name: Rotate
key_members.use: Rotate(AngleX, AngleY, AngleZ) in one call

key_members.name: Shading
key_members.use: cdrExtrudeShading: object fill, solid fill or colour shading

key_members.name: BaseColor
key_members.use: solid colour or shading start colour

key_members.name: ShadingColor
key_members.use: shading end colour

key_members.name: UseBevel
key_members.use: turn the bevel on

key_members.name: SetBevel
key_members.use: SetBevel(Depth, Angle, ShowBevelOnly)

key_members.name: BevelColor
key_members.use: bevel colour (when not using the extrude colour)

key_members.name: UseExtrudeColorForBevel
key_members.use: colour the bevel like the extrusion

key_members.name: SetLight
key_members.use: SetLight(Index, Position, LightIntensity) adds / moves a light

key_members.name: LightPresent
key_members.use: LightPresent(Index): whether that light is on

key_members.name: UseFullColorRange
key_members.use: let lighting use the full colour range

key_members.name: ExtrudeGroup
key_members.use: read-only group of generated side faces

key_members.name: FaceShape
key_members.use: read-only control (front face) object

key_members.name: CopyFrom
key_members.use: copy every extrude setting from another IVGEffectExtrude

gotchas: How the lights combine with each Shading mode (object fill vs solid vs colour shading) is not confirmed; check the result by eye (unverified)
The typelib gives no valid range for the light Index; read LightPresent(Index) before relying on an index (unverified)
For parallel types Depth has no effect; depth comes from the vanishing point offset (unverified)
Rotating an extrusion (AngleX/Y/Z) locks the vanishing point; later VP edits may be ignored until rotation is reset (unverified)
cards.example:
Dim e As Effect
Set e = ActiveShape.CreateExtrude(cdrExtrudeSmallBack, cdrVPLockedToShape, 0, -3, 20)
e.Extrude.Shading = cdrExtrudeColorShading
e.Extrude.BaseColor.CMYKAssign 0, 80, 100, 0
e.Extrude.ShadingColor.CMYKAssign 0, 100, 100, 60
e.Extrude.SetBevel 0.05, 45, False

review.changes: Removed the invented 1-3 light-index range from a gotcha.

cards.name: IVGEffectInnerShadow
cards.summary: Settings of a live inner shadow (Inner Shadow tool): a soft bitmap shadow drawn inside an object's edge, offset to look cut-in or with zero offset and a Depth for an even inset all round, with opacity, feather, colour and merge mode.
use_for: debossed / letterpress text and stamped logos
inset UI fields and pressed buttons
giving flat shapes a recessed, carved look
avoid: a shadow behind the object: use IVGEffectDropShadow
print jobs that must stay pure vector: the inner shadow is a bitmap
cards.how: Dispinterface (dual). Created with Shape.CreateInnerShadow(Opacity, Feather, OffsetX, OffsetY, Color, FeatherType, FeatherEdge, MergeMode, Depth) which returns an IVGEffect; .InnerShadow is this object. Existing ones: Shape.Effects.InnerShadowEffect.InnerShadow.

key_members.name: OffsetX
key_members.use: horizontal offset of the shadow inside the shape

key_members.name: OffsetY
key_members.use: vertical offset

key_members.name: SetOffset
key_members.use: SetOffset(OffsetX, OffsetY) in one call

key_members.name: Depth
key_members.use: inset depth used when the offset is zero (shadow all round)

key_members.name: Opacity
key_members.use: shadow opacity (long)

key_members.name: Feather
key_members.use: softness of the shadow edge

key_members.name: FeatherType
key_members.use: cdrFeatherType for the feather

key_members.name: FeatherEdge
key_members.use: cdrEdgeType falloff of the feather

key_members.name: Color
key_members.use: IVGColor of the shadow

key_members.name: MergeMode
key_members.use: cdrMergeMode: how the shadow blends with the object's fill (multiply is typical)

key_members.name: ShadowGroup
key_members.use: read-only shape holding the rendered inner-shadow bitmap

gotchas: Typelib describes Color as 'the feather color'; it is the shadow colour
Depth only matters when OffsetX and OffsetY are both 0 (per its description); with an offset the shadow is directional
The shadow is rasterised, so very large Feather values on big shapes make heavy files (unverified)
cards.example:
Dim e As Effect
Set e = ActiveShape.CreateInnerShadow(70, 6)
e.InnerShadow.SetOffset 0.03, -0.03
e.InnerShadow.MergeMode = cdrMergeMultiply
e.InnerShadow.Color.RGBAssign 0, 0, 0

review.changes: Opacity: removed the 0-100 range, which is not in the batch.

cards.name: IVGEffectLens
cards.summary: Settings of a live lens (Effects > Lens docker): a shape that changes how everything beneath it looks - magnify, fish eye, wireframe, colour limit, colour add, invert, brighten, tinted grayscale, heat map, transparency or a custom colour map - and can be frozen into real objects.
use_for: magnifier call-outs on maps, diagrams and product details
tinted or inverted window areas over artwork (colour add, invert, tinted grayscale)
frozen lens results turned into editable art for print
avoid: ordinary transparency on a single object: use the object's transparency instead of a lens
bitmap-quality adjustments: lenses work on vector colour and can look crude over photos
cards.how: Dispinterface (dual). Created with Shape.CreateLens(Type, RateOrMagnification, Color1, Color2, ColorMapPalette) which returns an IVGEffect; .Lens is this object. Existing ones: Shape.Effects.LensEffect.Lens. Which properties matter depends on Type.

key_members.name: Type
key_members.use: cdrLensType: cdrLensMagnify, cdrLensFishEye, cdrLensWireframe, cdrLensColorLimit, cdrLensColorAdd, cdrLensInvert, cdrLensBrighten, cdrLensTintedGrayscale, cdrLensHeatMap, cdrLensTransparency, cdrLensCustomColorMap

key_members.name: Rate
key_members.use: percentage strength for rate-based lenses (brighten, transparency, colour limit ...)

key_members.name: Magnification
key_members.use: zoom amount for cdrLensMagnify

key_members.name: Color
key_members.use: lens colour for colour add / colour limit / tinted grayscale / transparency

key_members.name: FromColor
key_members.use: start colour of a custom colour map

key_members.name: ToColor
key_members.use: end colour of a custom colour map

key_members.name: ColorMapPalette
key_members.use: cdrFountainFillBlendType route between FromColor and ToColor (direct or rainbow)

key_members.name: PaletteRotation
key_members.use: rotate the heat-map palette

key_members.name: OutlineColor
key_members.use: outline colour for the wireframe lens

key_members.name: FillColor
key_members.use: fill colour for the wireframe lens

key_members.name: UseOutlineColor
key_members.use: apply OutlineColor (wireframe)

key_members.name: UseFillColor
key_members.use: apply FillColor (wireframe)

key_members.name: UseViewPoint
key_members.use: show what is under a different point instead of directly beneath

key_members.name: ViewPointX
key_members.use: X of that viewpoint

key_members.name: ViewPointY
key_members.use: Y of that viewpoint

key_members.name: RemoveFace
key_members.use: apply the lens only where it overlaps objects, not the empty page

key_members.name: Freeze
key_members.use: bake the current lens view into a group of real objects

key_members.name: Unfreeze
key_members.use: make a frozen lens live again

key_members.name: Frozen
key_members.use: read-only: whether the lens is frozen

key_members.name: Shapes
key_members.use: sub-shapes of a frozen lens group

key_members.name: Ungroup
key_members.use: ungroup a frozen lens into a shape range

gotchas: Shapes and Ungroup only make sense after Freeze; on a live lens they are expected to be empty or fail (unverified)
The lens acts only inside the lens shape's own area; it cannot be applied to some effect groups (e.g. an extrude or blend group) (unverified)
Lenses over bitmaps can render and print slowly or differently from screen; freeze before final output (unverified)
cards.example:
Dim e As Effect
Set e = ActiveShape.CreateLens(cdrLensMagnify, 2)
e.Lens.UseViewPoint = True
e.Lens.ViewPointX = 3
e.Lens.ViewPointY = 4
e.Lens.RemoveFace = True

review.changes: Summary: named the menu path (Effects > Lens), which opens the Lens docker.

cards.name: IVGEffectPerspective
cards.summary: Settings of a live perspective (Object > Perspective > Add Perspective): the object is distorted as if receding toward a horizontal and / or vertical vanishing point, giving one- or two-point perspective.
use_for: putting artwork onto a wall, sign or box side in a mock-up
receding 'Star Wars' title text and floor-plane graphics
avoid: curved warps: use IVGEffectEnvelope
real 3D depth with sides: use IVGEffectExtrude
cards.how: Dispinterface (dual). Created with Shape.CreatePerspective(HorizVanishPointX, HorizVanishPointY, VertVanishPointX, VertVanishPointY) which returns an IVGEffect; .Perspective is this object. Existing ones: Shape.Effects.PerspectiveEffects(i).Perspective.

key_members.name: UseHorizVanishingPoint
key_members.use: turn the horizontal vanishing point on or off

key_members.name: HorizVanishingPointX
key_members.use: X of the horizontal vanishing point

key_members.name: HorizVanishingPointY
key_members.use: Y of the horizontal vanishing point

key_members.name: UseVertVanishingPoint
key_members.use: turn the vertical vanishing point on or off

key_members.name: VertVanishingPointX
key_members.use: X of the vertical vanishing point

key_members.name: VertVanishingPointY
key_members.use: Y of the vertical vanishing point

gotchas: Using only one vanishing point gives one-point perspective; both gives two-point (unverified)
Vanishing points are page coordinates in document units; a point inside or very near the object folds it inside out (unverified)
Perspective cannot be applied to some live effect groups (e.g. a drop shadow group) directly (unverified)
cards.example:
Dim e As Effect
Set e = ActiveShape.CreatePerspective(20, 4)
e.Perspective.UseVertVanishingPoint = False
e.Perspective.HorizVanishingPointX = 15

review.changes: Summary: menu path corrected to Object > Perspective > Add Perspective (harvested cdr_effect path).

cards.name: IVGEffectPushPullDistortion
cards.summary: The amount of a push-and-pull distortion: one Amplitude value that pushes an object's edges in toward the centre (spiky, star-like) or pulls them out (puffy, petal-like), depending on its sign.
use_for: starburst price badges and seals from a circle or polygon
flower and petal shapes from a simple polygon
avoid: exact star geometry: use the Star / Polygon shape with set points and sharpness
cards.how: Dispinterface (dual). Created with Shape.CreatePushPullDistortion(OriginX, OriginY, Amplitude); the returned IVGEffect's .Distortion.PushPull is this object. Its Parent is the IVGEffectDistortion holding the centre point.

key_members.name: Amplitude
key_members.use: long: strength and direction of the push / pull; sign picks push vs pull

key_members.name: Parent
key_members.use: the IVGEffectDistortion (Type, OriginX / OriginY, CenterDistortion)

gotchas: Which sign is push and which is pull, and the valid range, are not in the typelib; test on a copy (unverified)
Result depends heavily on the node count of the source shape; add nodes or use a polygon for an even burst (unverified)
cards.example:
Dim e As Effect
Set e = ActivePage.Shapes(1).CreatePushPullDistortion(0, 0, 50)
e.Distortion.CenterDistortion
e.Distortion.PushPull.Amplitude = -80

review.changes: Removed the invented -200..200 amplitude range from a gotcha.

cards.name: IVGEffects
cards.summary: The collection of live effects attached to one shape, with filtered sub-collections (blends, distortions, envelopes, perspectives, custom) and direct accessors for single-instance effects (contour, drop shadow, inner shadow, extrude, lens, text on path, control path).
use_for: checking whether an object carries a shadow / contour / extrude before editing it
pre-press audits listing every live effect in a document
bulk-removing or bulk-retuning one kind of effect across many shapes
avoid: bitmap effects applied from the Effects menu to bitmaps: not listed here
cards.how: Dispinterface (dual) collection. Reached as Shape.Effects; iterate with For Each (via _NewEnum) or Item(i) with i from 1 to Count. Each element is an IVGEffect.

key_members.name: Count
key_members.use: number of effects on the shape

key_members.name: Item
key_members.use: Item(Index) returns one IVGEffect, 1-based

key_members.name: _NewEnum
key_members.use: enables For Each over the effects

key_members.name: BlendEffects
key_members.use: only the blends the shape takes part in

key_members.name: DistortionEffects
key_members.use: only distortions

key_members.name: EnvelopeEffects
key_members.use: only envelopes

key_members.name: PerspectiveEffects
key_members.use: only perspectives

key_members.name: CustomEffects
key_members.use: only custom (plug-in) effects

key_members.name: ContourEffect
key_members.use: the contour on the shape

key_members.name: DropShadowEffect
key_members.use: the drop shadow on the shape

key_members.name: InnerShadowEffect
key_members.use: the inner shadow on the shape

key_members.name: ExtrudeEffect
key_members.use: the extrude on the shape

key_members.name: LensEffect
key_members.use: the lens on the shape

key_members.name: TextOnPathEffect
key_members.use: the text-on-path fit on the shape

key_members.name: ControlPathEffect
key_members.use: the effect representing blends / text this curve drives

key_members.name: Parent
key_members.use: the IVGShape owning the collection

gotchas: Single accessors (ContourEffect, DropShadowEffect ...) are expected to return Nothing when the shape has no such effect; test with Is Nothing (unverified)
A blend shows up on both control shapes, so a document-wide loop sees each blend twice; de-duplicate by BlendGroup (unverified)
Calling Clear / Separate while iterating with For Each changes the collection under you; loop backwards with Item(i) (unverified)
cards.example:
Dim s As Shape
For Each s In ActivePage.Shapes
  If Not s.Effects.DropShadowEffect Is Nothing Then
    s.Effects.DropShadowEffect.Clear
  End If
Next

cards.name: IVGEffectTextOnPath
cards.summary: Settings of text fitted to a path (Text > Fit Text to Path): which text and path are linked, the text's distance from and offset along the path, how letters are oriented, its alignment, which side of the path it sits on and its vertical placement.
use_for: circular seal and badge lettering around a logo
headlines following a wave, ribbon or road
stamp and emblem text on top and bottom arcs (PlaceOnOtherSide)
avoid: text that must bend as a whole block (multiple lines): use an envelope (IVGEffectEnvelope) on the text
paragraph text inside a shape: fit text into a frame instead
cards.how: Dispinterface (dual). Created with TextShape.Text.FitToPath(PathShape), which returns an IVGEffect; .TextOnPath is this object. Existing ones: Shape.Effects.TextOnPathEffect.TextOnPath (from the text shape).

key_members.name: Text
key_members.use: the fitted text shape; settable

key_members.name: Path
key_members.use: the path shape the text follows; settable

key_members.name: DistanceFromPath
key_members.use: gap between the path and the text

key_members.name: Offset
key_members.use: how far along the path the text starts

key_members.name: Orientation
key_members.use: cdrFittedOrientation: rotate letters, vertical / horizontal skew, upright, transform

key_members.name: Placement
key_members.use: cdrFittedPlacement: left, right or centre alignment on the path

key_members.name: VertPlacement
key_members.use: cdrFittedVertPlacement: baseline, ascender, descender, centre or custom on the path

key_members.name: PlaceOnOtherSide
key_members.use: flip the text to the other side of the path

key_members.name: Quadrant
key_members.use: cdrFittedQuadrant: left / right / top / bottom placement on closed paths

gotchas: Quadrant is the legacy placement for closed paths (ellipses); on open paths Placement and Offset decide the position (unverified)
Typelib calls the vertical-placement enum 'cdrFittedVerPlacement' in the description; the real type is cdrFittedVertPlacement
Deleting the path leaves the text with no effect; Separate first if the path must go (unverified)
cards.example:
Dim t As Shape, p As Shape, e As Effect
Set t = ActiveLayer.CreateArtisticText(0, 0, "SEAL OF QUALITY")
Set p = ActiveLayer.CreateEllipse2(3, 3, 2)
Set e = t.Text.FitToPath(p)
e.TextOnPath.Placement = cdrCenterPlacement
e.TextOnPath.DistanceFromPath = 0.05

equivalents.AI: Type/Type on a Path/Type on a Path Options...

review.changes: Example now creates its own text and path instead of assuming ActivePage.Shapes(1) is text and Shapes(2) is a path.
